name: Dughlat Emirate
alt: Dughlat Kingdom of Kashgar and Yarkand

predecessors.name: Moghulistan
predecessors.text: 'in 1465, he founded in Western Kashgaria a kingdom based at Yarkand'

successors.name: Yarkent Khanate (Eastern Moghulistan)
successors.text: Kashgar, taken by Sultan Said Khan in 1514, and the rest of the emirate; the Yarkent Khanate of Cliopatria's Eastern Moghulistan row

ledger.x: 1465: Mirza Abu Bakr Dughlat founds a kingdom at Yarkand.
1514: Sultan Said Khan takes Kashgar and ends the Dughlat kingdom.

wars.name: Abu Bakr's revolt against Yunus Khan
wars.outcome: Abu Bakr 'successfully resisted' Yunus Khan's attacks and kept his kingdom, then took Kashgar in 1480.

wars.name: Sultan Said Khan's conquest of Kashgaria
wars.outcome: Said Khan took Kashgar in 1514; Abu Bakr was killed in flight; his son Jahangir Mirza held the government briefly.

certainty.note: Oasis towns with desert and mountain edges; the page names three holdings and no frontier.
